title: digest_cli
description: Digest projection of the CLI surface (tools/specdev_tools/cli.py or subcommand modules). Captures subcommand names, required/accepted flags, and known strip behaviour for documentation-parity and drift checks.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a CLI digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root (e.g. tools/specdev_tools/cli.py).

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

commands.description: Array of subcommand descriptors extracted from argparse add_parser() calls.

env_vars.description: Environment variable names referenced in the CLI source (SPECDEV_* pattern).

command_descriptor.description: A single CLI subcommand and its flag contract.

name.description: Subcommand name as passed to add_parser() (e.g. validate, spec-check, canon-accept).

required_flags.description: Flag names (--flag) that are positional or declared required=True.

accepted_flags.description: All flag names accepted by this subcommand including optional ones.

strips_flags.description: Flags that this subcommand silently strips before processing (documented in source). Empty when none are documented. Do not fabricate — populate only when the strip is explicitly coded.

positional_args.description: Names of positional (non-flag) arguments in declaration order.
